name: robots/zichunxx__panda_mujoco_gym
title: Franka Panda pick-and-place scene (panda_mujoco_gym)
intro: Franka Panda pick-and-place scene (panda_mujoco_gym), adapted from zichunxx/panda_mujoco_gym. It reads `time_ms`, `qpos`, `qvel`, `ctrl` and 4 more; runs `step` and `reset`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
